scope: Inactive exact-source native BB script automation proposal only
dependencies: running BB server on operator workstation
existing active wg0 routes to private exporter and vault
existing workstation cert identity and renewal
existing bao-exec guarded credential broker and locked venv
credential_boundary: Only operator memory; no credentials copied into workloads or new dotenv; native S3 helper not invoked
failure_ownership: One rate-limited closed phase notice to existing root thread; native three-failure pause, unknown journal holds retained
coverage: Conditional on host/BB/VPN availability; no reboot-safe claim. Source dump age <=25h; daily cadence can yield up to49h source-point lag plus outage under phase drift.
timeout_budget: No-print auth <=30s, broker fetch + fixed300s guarded child <=390s, durable metadata <=90s, one owner notice <=20s; native outer10m
durable_history_policy: Union prior durable and local history, retain prior last_backup if newer, reject conflicting immutable object bindings before CAS
